accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.openingNote: Take the opening balance from the bank statement on this date. It may be zero or negative. Movements before this date are rejected.
accounts.archiveNote: The history stays, but the account leaves the entry forms and the dashboard.

inbox.title: AI Inbox
inbox.description: Messages and cheque photos read by AI. Check each one, correct it if needed, then approve or reject. Nothing counts in a balance until it is approved.
inbox.photoUnavailable: The photo could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
inbox.photoDeleted: The photo was deleted when the entry was rejected.
inbox.duplicateWarning: A transfer with the same account, amount, date and reference already exists. Check the details, then press Approve again to save it anyway.
inbox.rejectNote: Nothing is saved to the ledger. A photo is deleted.

warnings.accountUnresolved: Not clear which of our accounts this is. Choose one.
warnings.accountNoTransfers: This account does not receive transfers.
warnings.accountNoCheques: This account does not issue cheques.
warnings.counterpartyMissing: No sender, beneficiary or payee found.

warnings.dateMissing: No date found: today’s date is filled in.

warnings.dateFarPast: The date {value} is more than 6 months ago.

warnings.amountWordsMissing: Could not read the amount in words to double-check the digits.

input.title: New entry
input.label: Describe the transfer or cheque, or add a cheque photo
input.placeholder: e.g. استلمنا تحويل 15 ألف من شركة النور على حساب CIB امبارح
input.sent: Added below. Check it, then approve or reject.

errors.emptyInput: Type a message or add a photo.
errors.textTooLong: The message is too long: 2,000 characters at most.
errors.imageTooLarge: The photo is too large even after shrinking. Try another photo.
errors.imageUnsupported: This file can't be read as a photo. Use a JPEG or PNG photo.
errors.aiUnavailable: The AI service didn't respond. Nothing was saved and your message is still here: please try again in a minute.
errors.aiUnreadable: The AI couldn't read this. Write it more clearly, or take a sharper photo, and try again.
errors.aiFailed: The AI service is not set up correctly, so trying again won't help. Please tell an admin.
errors.uploadFailed: The photo couldn't be saved. Nothing was saved: please try again.
errors.nothingFound: No amount and no direction (money in or out) found. Nothing was saved: write the amount and whether money came in or went out.

inbox.futureDateNote: {date} is after today. For a bank transfer, use the day our account was debited: a receipt may show a later settlement date.

telegram.help: Send me a message about a bank transfer or a cheque we issued, or a photo of a cheque. I will read it and put it in the AI Inbox, where it waits for approval before it counts in any balance.
telegram.saved: Added to the AI Inbox. It is waiting for approval.
telegram.notAllowed: Your account can only view. Ask an admin for the accountant role to send entries.
telegram.unsupported: I can read text messages and photos only.
telegram.downloadFailed: Could not get the photo from Telegram. Nothing was saved: please send it again.
telegram.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved: please try again later.

statements.title: Bank statements
statements.intro: Upload a bank statement (NBE: MT940, CIB: CSV) to check it against the ledger. Nothing changes in the ledger by importing.

warnings.startsAfterOpening: This is the first statement for this account, but it starts on {statementDate}. It should start on or before {openingDate} to check the opening balance.
warnings.openingBalanceMismatch: On {date} the statement shows {statement}, but the account opening balance is {app}. The opening balance is not changed automatically.
warnings.gap: Days between {from} and {to} are not covered by any imported statement.
warnings.previousBalanceMismatch: On {date} this statement shows {statement}, but the previous statement closed at {previous}.
warnings.nothingNew: Every line of this statement was already imported.

errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large for a statement.
errors.accountUnknown: No active account has the account number in this statement.
errors.missingTag: The statement is incomplete ({detail} is missing).
errors.badBalance: A balance in the statement could not be read.
errors.badLine: A statement line could not be read ({detail}).
errors.badAmount: An amount in the statement could not be read ({detail}).
errors.currencyMismatch: The opening and closing balances have different currencies.
errors.unbalanced: The lines do not add up from the opening to the closing balance, so the file was not read correctly. Nothing was imported.
errors.unknownFormat: This file is not a supported statement (NBE MT940 or CIB CSV).
errors.badDate: A date in the statement could not be read ({detail}).
errors.missingColumn: The statement is missing the column "{detail}".

list.title: Imported statements
list.deleteNote: Removes this statement and its lines, and undoes everything done from it: matches are removed, cheques it cleared go back to outstanding, and records created from it are voided or cancelled.

match.dayDiff: {days, plural, =0 {same day} one {# day apart} other {# days apart}}
match.datedLater: dated {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the bank: check it is the same transfer

types.cheque: Old cheque (issued before the start date)

create.fromLine: Date, amount and bank reference come from the statement line. An old cheque is recorded as issued and cleared on this day.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# line to review} other {# lines to review}}

checks.title: Checks
checks.continuityOk: Continues from the previous statement (or the opening balance) without a gap.
checks.bankOnly: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} on the statement, not in the app
checks.ignored: {count, plural, one {# ignored line} other {# ignored lines}}
checks.appOnly: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} in the app, not on the statement yet
checks.timing: {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} dated on the other side of {date}
checks.unexplainedNote: No line explains this: a statement may be missing, or the opening balance differs from the bank.
checks.reconciled: Fully reconciled: every line is accounted for.
checks.notReconciled: Not reconciled yet: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} to review.

review.closingOk: The app matches the bank on {date}.
review.beforeStart: {count, plural, one {# line is} other {# lines are}} before the start date and only used for the balance checks.

sure.title: Sure matches
sure.summary: {count, plural, one {# line matches} other {# lines match}} exactly one record in the app.
sure.confirmAllCount: Confirm {count, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}}

decide.title: Needs your decision
decide.intro: Compare the bank line with the record from the app: same fields, in the same order.

missing.title: Missing in the app
missing.intro: No record in the app for these lines: create one, or ignore the line.
missing.bulkFees: Create {count, plural, one {# fee} other {# fees}}
missing.bulkInterest: Create {count, plural, one {# interest record} other {# interest records}}
missing.bulkNote: One record per line that has no possible record in the app.

done.title: Done
done.show: Show {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
done.undoMatchedNote: Removes the match. A cheque cleared by it goes back to outstanding.
done.undoCreatedNote: Voids the record created from this line (a cheque is cancelled). Records are never deleted.
